title: Byzantine Remains in Palestine II. A Small Monastery and Chapel outside the 'Third Wall'
author: D. C. Baramki
location_note: Corner of Coeur de Lion and St. Paul Street, Sa'ad wa Sa'id quarter, Jerusalem; no map reference; placed by name.
notes: Room A, chapel, rooms B-D and corridor with mosaic floors, two phases; dated by the excavator to the 8th century (Iconoclastic period) by the mosaics. Floor sumps not coded.

features.period: eighth century (building, by analogy of mosaics; excavator)
